name: image-seo
description: > Image SEO audit — make a site's images discoverable in Google Images and stop them from dragging down Core Web Vitals. Audits alt text quality and coverage, descriptive file names, modern formats (WebP/AVIF), dimensions and compression, responsive srcset, lazy-loading, explicit width/height (CLS), image sitemaps, and ImageObject structured data.
